mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current level) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS below 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 258.5 signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 258.5 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in payroll employment (UNRATE > 0.5pp increase and PAYEMS < 0.2% decrease in 1 month) signals labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off flows and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp and PAYEMS falls > 0.2% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE > 6.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1200.0 (thousands of units) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances with HOUST > 1200.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 99.0 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances with INDPRO < 99.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level above 536000.0 (millions of dollars) signals strong consumer spending, boosting corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with RSAFS > 536000.0 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A payroll employment level above 140000.0 (thousands of persons) indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with PAYEMS > 140000.0 over any 1-year rolling window.
